points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in large-scale legal document workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for defensible insights.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring rigorous model output calibration.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and optimizing inference latency on self-hosted infrastructure.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in optimizing complex orchestration pipelines.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable LLM serving solutions using Docker and vLLM, ensuring robust pipelines for high-throughput inference.
